market_overview: Across the evidence packet, sentiment is mixed with notable bearish tones on interest rates, equities, inflation and gold, while oil and the U.S. dollar show bullish bias. Rate coverage is largely bearish due to Fed‑linked concerns, yet some neutral views persist. Oil headlines are uniformly bullish despite a recent dip in direction balance, reflecting geopolitical and supply worries. AI coverage is conflicted, leaning bearish amid slowdown debates. Equity reports split between neutral and bearish, mirroring higher yields and oil pressure. Inflation and gold remain contested but tilt bearish. Bitcoin shows modest bullish direction but mixed coverage. Overall, markets face divergent pressures from central‑bank policy, geopolitical risk and commodity moves, creating a mixed/neutral global PSI of 47.
